newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen starting lower, consolidating.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen starting lower, consolidating.

text.p: French shares were expected to open softer, traders said, with the market consolidating Wednesday's two percent rise which brought the Paris bourse to a fresh historic closing high.
The market could drift of ahead the 1230 GMT release of U.S. April consumer prices data, which are forecast to show a 0.2 percent increase in the core index, excluding food and energy.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 55.05 points or 2.02 percent at 2,774.63. The CAC-40 May futures contract was down six points at 2,758 from Wednesday's close.
